CLARA’S HOMEWORK · 26 SEPTEMBER 2026
Englishrelative clauses: saying two things at once

You can add extra information about someone or something in the middle of a sentence with who or which. Put a comma on each side.

who for a person (or a pet with a name)
which for a thing
Write each sentence again. Add a who or which part in the middle, with a comma on each side.

Example

Our teacher gave us a riddle.

Our teacher, who loves puzzles, gave us a riddle.

2
